# 🌲 TimberLegion ### *The Ultimate Realistic Woodcutting Experience* ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0.0-2ecc71?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft) ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.13%20--%201.21+-3498db?style=for-the-badge&logo=spigot) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-f1c40f?style=for-the-badge)
**TimberLegion** revolutionizes survival gameplay by turning woodcutting into a satisfying, physics-based event.
*Say goodbye to floating tree tops and hello to immersive forestry!*
สวัสดี(ติดต่อได้ดิสคอร์ดfov23)
--- ## 🌟 Why TimberLegion? | 🚀 **Performance First** | 🎮 **Gameplay Focused** | 🛡️ **Server Safe** | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Optimized algorithms ensure no lag, even on massive trees. | RPG rewards, sound effects, and particles make chopping addictive. | Respects WorldGuard, GriefPrevention, and tracks player-placed blocks. |
## 🔥 Key Features ### 🪓 **Realistic Mechanics** - **Chain Reaction:** Chop the bottom log, and the whole tree topples. - **Top-Down Breaking:** Logs break from top to bottom for visual realism. - **Smart Leaf Decay:** Leaves vanish smoothly around the tree. - **Auto-Replant:** Automatically replants saplings so your forests never run dry. ### 🎁 **RPG Reward System** *Turn lumberjacking into a treasure hunt!* - **Custom Loot:** Configurable drops from leaves (Apples, Sticks, or even Diamonds!). - **Biome Specific:** Different rewards for Overworld trees vs Nether fungus. - **Mythical Drops:** Rare drops trigger global sound effects and chat announcements. ### 🐔 **The "Chicken Bomb" Event** - **Easter Egg:** A configurable, rare chance (default 1%) for a tree to explode into a flock of glowing chickens! - **Fun Factor:** Adds a surprise element to the grind. ### ⚙️ **Player & Admin Friendly** - **In-Game GUI:** Players can toggle features personally via `/tc gui`. - **Admin Panel:** Edit config settings directly in-game without restarting. - **Safety:** Option to require sneaking (Shift) or double-break confirmation to prevent accidents. --- ## ✅ Compatibility & Support ### 🖥️ Server Software - **Supported:** Spigot, Paper, Purpur, Pufferfish - **Recommended:** Paper or Purpur (for best performance) ### 🎮 Minecraft Versions - **Range:** 1.13 - 1.21+ - **Note:** Fully supports new blocks like Cherry, Mangrove, and Nether stems. ### 🛡️ Protection Integration TimberLegion automatically respects region protections. If a player cannot break a block normally, the tree will **not** topple. - **WorldGuard** - **GriefPrevention** - **Towny** - **Lands** --- ## 📥 Installation 1. **Download** the `TimberLegion.jar`. 2. **Upload** it to your server's `plugins` folder. 3. **Restart** the server. 4. *(Optional)* Edit `config.yml` to customize drops and rates. 5. **Done!** No extra dependencies needed. --- ## Commands ### 👤 Player Commands | Command | Permission | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/tc gui` | `treecutter.use` | **Open the personal settings menu** | | `/tc help` | None | View list of commands | ### 👮 Admin Commands | Command | Permission | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/tc reload` | `treecutter.admin` | Reload configuration from disk | | `/tc debug` | `treecutter.admin` | Run system diagnostics & check conflicts | | `/tc toggle` | `treecutter.admin` | Quick-toggle the plugin for yourself | | `/tc ap` | `treecutter.admin` | Quick-toggle Auto-Plant for yourself | | `/tc fx` | `treecutter.admin` | Quick-toggle Effects for yourself | ## 🔐 Permissions | Permission | Default | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `treecutter.use` | **True** (Everyone) | Allows players to use the timber mechanic and open the settings menu (`/tc gui`). | | `treecutter.admin` | **OP** | Grants access to admin commands (`reload`, `debug`) and the Admin Panel in the GUI. | --- ## 🔧 Configuration Customize every aspect in `config.yml`. ```yaml # ⚙️ Core Settings max_blocks: 200 # Limit blocks to prevent lag require_sneak: true # Require Shift to chop # 🎁 Rewards reward_chance: 0.001 # 0.1% chance for custom drops rewards: DIAMOND: 0.1 # Extremely rare drop! # 🐔 Events chicken_bomb_chance: 0.01 # 1% chance of chicken explosion
